responsibilities.description: Governs the sanitization, redaction, and preparation of incoming user data and contextual information to ensure safety and privacy before processing.

responsibility_constraints.description: All user-provided input must be sanitized of harmful characters or patterns.
Personally identifiable information (PII) must be redacted from contextual data before being passed to the reasoning engine.

process_model_parts.description: Current set of identified harmful patterns or character sequences for sanitization.
Classification of data fields as PII or non-PII within the current context.
The raw state of the input versus the sanitized/redacted state for verification.

responsibilities.description: Manages the validation and execution of tool calls, ensuring they adhere to deterministic business logic and security boundaries.

responsibility_constraints.description: Tool execution payloads must be validated against deterministic business rules and workflow constraints prior to execution.
Tool execution capabilities must be restricted to a predefined subset of non-administrative functions, regardless of model reasoning.

process_model_parts.description: The schema and business rule definitions for all available tools.
The authorization level and functional scope permitted for the current session/user.
The proposed tool payload generated by the reasoning engine.

responsibilities.description: Governs the integrity and security of the reasoning process, including the protection of traces, logs, and grounding data.

responsibility_constraints.description: Access to system-level prompts and reasoning traces must be restricted to authorized observability functions.
Access controls and integrity checks must be enforced on all grounding data.
Reasoning traces and tool execution logs must be recorded in an immutable format.
Integrity of reasoning traces and execution logs must be monitored for unauthorized modifications.

process_model_parts.description: The current authorization mapping for accessing system prompts and traces.
The integrity checksums or version history of reasoning traces and logs.
The current state and provenance of grounding data used for model responses.

responsibilities.description: Monitors and validates the quality, safety, and fairness of the model's output before it is delivered to the user.

responsibility_constraints.description: Fairness and bias detection checks must be performed on reasoning outputs.
Harmful content must be verified as absent in the output stream using multiple independent verification processes.

process_model_parts.description: The generated output content from the reasoning engine.
The status and results of independent content moderation and bias detection checks.

responsibilities.description: Manages resource allocation and environment security to prevent exhaustion and unauthorized configuration changes.

responsibility_constraints.description: Request volume and token consumption must be limited per user session.
Identity and access management must be enforced for development and testing environments.
A peer review process must be required for all production configuration changes.

process_model_parts.description: Current token usage and request count per active user session.
The current configuration state and the history of approved peer reviews for changes.
The identity and permission set of the current operator/environment user.

responsibilities.description: Governs human oversight and escalation for sensitive or high-risk interactions.

process_model_parts.description: The classification of the current interaction as requiring human intervention based on risk or complexity.
The status of the escalation (e.g., pending, in-progress, resolved by human).

control_actions.description: Log reasoning trace to immutable storage
